evals.prompt: Help me set Q1 goals: launch a new league, improve the main product, get more members.
evals.expected_output: Objectives with numeric key results, baselines, owners and a side-time share.
expectations: Turns each goal into key results with a number, baseline, target, date and owner
Marks values it supplied as proposal
Sets a side-time share in hours per week
Leaves approval of the set with the owner

evals.prompt: The quarter ended. Our key result was 500 paying members and we got 310. What now?
evals.expected_output: A 0 to 1 grade with a verdict and no mid-quarter rewrite.
expectations: Grades the key result about 0.6 from 310 of 500
Writes the grade even though the target was missed
Gives keep, change or stop for the objective
Does not send or post the grades
